name: Eating
overview: Scripture reveals that eating is both a provision from God and a communal activity marked by hospitality and celebration. From the creation account where God grants plants and fruits for food (Genesis 1:29), to the post-flood allowance of animals for meat (Genesis 9:3), the Bible sets clear boundaries and blessings around what and how we eat. Scenes of shared meals, such as Abraham serving his guests (Genesis 18:8) and the special honor given to favored guests with larger portions (Genesis 43:34), highlight the social and gracious aspects of eating. Additionally, the people’s participation in offerings and communal feasting (Exodus 32:6) underscores eating as a sacred and ordered practice under God’s commands, as introduced in Leviticus 11.
